contradictions.title: Report claims launcher visibly rendered while its own matrix says 0/15
contradictions.claim: F0_25E_FINAL_REPORT.md section 1 item 6 (also evaluator L589 static string): '[DERIVED_FROM_FROZEN_EVIDENCE] UI presentation stacking was fixed: AstraRun launcher is HWND_TOPMOST, rendering visibly on the desktop.'
contradictions.contradicted_by: Same report section 5 table: all 15 frames Astra Launcher Visible=False; ASTRA_LAUNCHER_UI=FAIL; USER_OBSERVABILITY=FAIL. MIMO pixel inspection of all 15 PNGs: no Astra window anywhere. world_frames astra_windows=[] 15/15; window_count=14 unchanged from baseline.
contradictions.note: The claim is a canned string stamped [DERIVED_FROM_FROZEN_EVIDENCE] though nothing derives from evidence; source DOES implement WindowStaysOnTopHint (launcher.py:216-218) and SetWindowPos HWND_TOPMOST (presentation.py:62) - implementation exists, observable effect does not.

contradictions.title: Astra self-log says launcher visible; screen and enumeration say absent
contradictions.claim: Production log (corroborating evidence): launcher presented at (448,48) 20:45:43, state=INTERACTIVE vis=True act=True focus=True through 20:45:45; IPC SHOW_MAIN_UI/POPULATE/SUBMIT all received.

contradictions.root_cause: UNKNOWN - candidate mechanisms (Qt window never mapped to a visible Win32 HWND despite Qt-level state; immediate unmapping not logged; capture/enumeration desktop mismatch) cannot be distinguished post-hoc. Not minimized/transparent/off-screen evidence either way.
